title: Clinic ke repeat sawaal - AI assistant
content:
Aapka clinic roz wahi DAS sawaal ka jawab deta hai?
Timing kya hai? Fees kitni hai? Report kab milegi?
Let an AI assistant handle the repeats, and let your staff handle the patients.
Socho reception pe kya hota hai.
Ek patient saamne khada hai, aur phone baj raha hai.
WhatsApp pe bees messages pending hain.
Aur unme se zyada tar sawaal same hote hain.
That is not a people problem. It is a repetition problem.
Main dikhata hoon ye assistant kaise kaam karta hai.
Ye ek walkthrough hai, kisi clinic ka result nahi.
Step ONE... clinic ki ek simple FAQ sheet banao.
Timings, doctors ke din, fees, address, report collection, insurance.
The assistant answers ONLY from this sheet.
Step TWO... isko WhatsApp ya website chat se jodo.
Patient poochta hai, "Sunday ko khula hai?"
Assistant sheet se jawab deta hai, turant.
No waiting, no missed message at eleven at night.
Par ab sabse zaroori rule aata hai.
Isko skip kiya, toh pura system risky ho jaata hai.
Step THREE... medical sawaal pe AI kabhi jawab nahi dega.
"Ye dawai le sakta hoon?" jaisa sawaal seedha staff ke paas jaayega.
The assistant says, "Our team will call you back," and flags it.
AI admin ka kaam karta hai. Doctor ka kaam doctor karta hai.
Step FOUR... appointment ka request bhi le sakta hai.
Naam, din aur time lo, aur staff ko bhejo.
A human confirms the slot, so nothing gets double booked.
Kitna time bachega? Honestly, ye aapke clinic pe depend karta hai.
Maan lo aap ek hafte tak count karo ki kitne sawaal repeat hote hain.
Wahi number aapko batayega ki ye worth it hai ya nahi.
Mera take simple hai... pehle repeats automate karo, baaki sab baad mein.
Start small, measure honestly, then expand.
Aapke clinic, shop ya agency ke liye ye chahiye? DM me if you want this for your business.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
